title: SCA Minhag of the Week 212: "The Blessing on Thunder and Lightning"

chapters.title: Blessings on natural occurrences
chapters.about: Maran on reciting blessings for thunder and lightning

chapters.title: Authorities on omitting Hashem's name
chapters.about: Rabad, Meiri, and Middle Eastern customs

chapters.title: Documentation of customs

chapters.about: Sephardic custom and the Kaf HaChaim

summary: The teacher discusses the different customs regarding whether to include Hashem's name when reciting blessings for natural phenomena like thunder and lightning. He reviews the opinions of various authorities, including Maran, the Rabad, the Meiri, and the Kaf HaChaim, regarding these blessings and other natural wonders.
questions: Should Hashem's name be included in the blessing for thunder and lightning?
What are the two versions of the blessing for natural occurrences?
What is the custom in the Middle East regarding these blessings?
Which natural occurrences besides thunder and lightning require these blessings?
What was the custom in Halab regarding these blessings?
